title: UsageReceipt v1
description: Normalized resource receipt for one physical model call. Carries a REQUIRED trust tier. `chargedTokens` and `chargedCostMicroUsd` are NEVER null: when telemetry is absent the charged values are the published tier ceiling (`estimated_tier_ceiling`) or the caller's config-pinned non-zero floor (`unavailable`). This closes the silent-zero gap (Inbox action-pilot always reported unavailable/cost 0; JobTrack validateUsage accepted floor-0 receipts with no trust tier). Observed values are null ONLY when trust does not carry that observation. The non-zero-floor rule for `estimated_tier_ceiling`/`unavailable` (`chargedTokens>=1` AND `chargedCostMicroUsd>=1`) is a cross-field invariant the JSON Schema cannot express; it is enforced code-side (JobTrack `validateUsageReceipt`). Consumers MUST run both the schema and the code-side validator.

trust.description: provider_signed: cryptographically attested by the provider (requires `signature`). provider_reported: provider returned usage but unsigned. estimated_tier_ceiling: no trustworthy telemetry; charged the exact published per-attempt ceiling. unavailable: no adapter plumbed provider usage AND no ceiling applies (charged values are still non-null, set by the caller's own floor policy).

signature.description: Opaque provider-signed-receipt token. Present ONLY when trust=provider_signed. Never grants authority; it is verified out of band. See OPEN DECISION on signature format.

allOf.description: estimated_tier_ceiling and unavailable carry no observed telemetry.
provider_reported and provider_signed must carry at least one observed value.
A signature is present exactly when trust=provider_signed.
